Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Add not-in-scope message for unknown compounds in Fate Explorer

- Add compound_found field to API response to distinguish between
  "compound not in database" vs "no pathways match filters"
- Display helpful message when querying unknown compounds:
  "This compound is not in the AEGIS database..."
- Show filter adjustment guidance when compound exists but has no
  matching pathways
- Add i18n translations for English and Japanese

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Filter Fate Explorer dropdown to fluorinated compounds only

Uses RDKit chemistry to detect fluorine atoms \(atomic number 9\) from SMILES,
with string-pattern fallback for unresolved compounds. Removes 74 non-fluorinated
entries \(pharmaceuticals, dyes, plastics, intermediates\) from 260 -> 186 compounds.

- Add _is_fluorinated_compound\(\) with RDKit-first approach
- Load SMILES from smiles_enrichment.json and compound_registry_clean.json
- Exclude intermediate labels \(IM2, INT3, S1, etc.\) via regex
- Log before/after filter statistics on startup

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Add loading indicators to SENTINEL and backend keep-alive

- Add loading spinners to SENTINEL compound buttons \(PFOA/GenX\) during data fetch
- Add initial "Loading case studies..." state on page load
- Create useBackendWarmup hook to ping /health every 4 minutes
- Prevents Railway cold start delays by keeping backend warm

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")

Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
feat: Add visible DOI links to pathway cards

Display source DOIs directly on pathway cards below the evidence
strength bar, making every claim traceable at a glance. Shows up to 3
DOI badges with a "+N more" button for overflow that expands the
evidence section.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
